thread:
kevin: Hey team — opened PR to bump openssl from 1.1.1s -> 1.1.1t to pull in the latest security fixes for CVE-XXXX-YYYY. CI green, docker image build included. Can someone take a quick look today? Need to merge before tomorrow's base-image build. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1234

maria: Thanks for the ping. Quick question — is this a pure patch bump (no ABI changes) or do we need to rebuild/publish any pinned wheels/artifacts?

kevin: Should be pure patch, no ABI break expected. I rebuilt the python wheels in a qemu job and they look fine. Also added a dedicated image build job in CI and smoke tests passed. Snippet from CI logs: ```Build base-image: SUCCESS
Run smoke: all tests ok (openssl 1.1.1t)```

alex: I'll take a look this afternoon. If it's non-breaking we can fast-track. Can you add a short rollback plan to the PR (how to pin back previous image + redeploy)?

kevin: Done — PR description now has rollback steps and a canary pipeline target (`baseimage-canary`). Also included an ops playbook snippet for redeploy: ```ansible-playbook -i inventory/hosts deploy.yml -e image_tag=baseimage:2026-03-01```

sam: Quick :+1: for visibility. Please loop in support if we're changing runtime images.

deploy-bot: automated scan: no new transitive high-severity vulns introduced. report: https://scans.internal.redwood/cve-report/1234

maria: pinging @eng-sre — can you monitor the canary rollout?

jamie (oncall): I can monitor. Prefer the canary window 10:00-12:00 PST tomorrow. Can someone schedule it and post the pipeline URL?

kevin: Scheduled the canary for 10:15 PST and added the pipeline link in the PR. Merge is blocked by 1 approval — Alex, can you approve if packaging tests look ok?

alex: Left one tiny comment about an extra test flake, but it's non-blocking. Approved now. :shipit:

kevin: Merged main -> bumped base image tag and triggered downstream image builds. Thanks all for the quick review — I will follow up in #release-notes once the new image is promoted to canary and then stable.

sam: Thanks — I'll notify support about the scheduled deploy and update the incident slack channel if anything pops during canary.
